prompt_for_grok_imagine:
Apply the Product Showcase featured template. 

Clean high-end studio product photography presentation of a single premium futuristic holographic ID badge / digital collectible playing card as the central "product" being showcased. The badge has glossy iridescent holographic glass-like material, strong rainbow refraction and light play, subtle scanlines, floating 3D depth, sci-fi high-tech aesthetic.

The card prominently features the exact person from the reference headshot photo (preserve 100% identity, face shape, skin tone, hair, expression, and likeness in the initial clear portrait layer).

The design shows a smooth cinematic holographic left pan / morph transition: starting with the sharp clear headshot portrait on the card -> shimmering iridescent holo dissolve and left pan revealing a highly detailed anatomically accurate skull with evolutionary bone structure -> continued pan and reveal through the skull to upper bones and skeleton (clavicles, ribs, vertebrae, humerus etc.) all in the same holographic iridescent floating style with subtle glowing bone landmarks.

For the skull and skeleton layer use precise real-world hominin fossil anatomy: ['Australian Museum: multiple Homo neanderthalensis skulls (Amud 1, Le Moustier, Gibraltar, youth, 1, Galilee partial)', 'Bone Clones: extensive Neanderthal skulls, skeletons, postcranial (full sets, reconstructions by Sawyer/Maley)', 'Smithsonian 3D hominin (Neanderthal scans)']. with 1.8% Neanderthal archaic admixture (from ~50kya Eurasian contact) expressing as long low-vaulted cranium with prominent double-arched supraorbital torus and occipital bun, receding forehead, large robust midface with broad nose and midfacial prognathism, weak or absent chin, stocky cold-adapted body with barrel chest, short distal limbs, thick bones, powerful build, pale-medium skin with excellent multiple scattering subsurface and tiger-stripe potential under side light, robust hair patterns.

Motion for video: 5-7 second fluid sequence with gentle left-to-right or horizontal pan showing the full holo transition from portrait -> skull -> bones/skeleton -> final augmented card state. Match the holographic skull pan motion style and final augmented aesthetic of reference videos. High production value, smooth, premium.

Stills: the finished holographic badge perfectly framed in Product Showcase style — centered on clean minimal dark gradient or reflective backdrop, soft studio key + fill + rim lighting on the edges of the badge, tack sharp, luxurious collectible card product shot.

Overall aesthetic: futuristic holo ancestor ID badge / digital playing card suitable for a collectible deck. Include very small elegant text if desired: "Homo neanderthalensis (Neanderthals) • Middle-Upper Pleistocene ~400-40 kya" or migration hint. No clutter.

Reference photo subject must remain perfectly recognizable in the portrait state. Holo and bone layers are stylistic reveals only.

Additional: Comprehensive coverage of face, body, bones, IK/poses, shapes from early hominins (fossil refs: Smithsonian 3D, Australian Museum casts, Bone Clones) through archaic to anatomically modern Homo sapiens. Unified 'solid_column' per stage for iterative genetic migration lineage estimations. Designed for character bibles in Grok Imagine prompts, consistency across generations, and holo ID badge card prototyping (Spline/Three.js/Mixamo rigs). Source data synthesized from public collections + genetic studies (admixture estimates ~1-6% archaic in modern populations depending on path). Use accurate bone details from the lineage for the chosen stage.
